gate_reader.behavior: On the source-0 branch, bit 0 is isolated. If it is zero, CR0 EQ branches to the epilogue; if it is one, execution falls through to call 0x823A4640.

static_scan.coverage_limit: This is an instruction/disassembly scan for direct address materialization and 0x6544 operands. It does not find alias writes through unrelated pointers or writes made by host/MMIO devices.

supported: The direct guest-code reference found for 0x7FC86544 is the source-0 gate load at 0x823B3830; the source-0 path calls 0x823A4640 only when bit 0 is one.
Eight sampled entries at 0x823A4640 show the gate was passed in the recorded run, while the deferred queue indices remained zero.
not_proven: The source or owner that sets bit 0 at 0x7FC86544; it may be written through an alias or host/MMIO path not visible as a direct guest-code reference.
